cross_references.relationship: PARALLEL_TRACK — §2234 gross negligence (Board discipline) and civil malpractice negligence (§3333.2 cap) are independent proceedings against the same physician conduct. Board discipline does not establish civil liability; civil judgment does not trigger automatic Board action.

APPLICATION — SIRVA cases (negligent injection technique) may constitute §2234(b) gross negligence if the injection technique was an extreme departure, or §2234(c) repeated acts if the provider had multiple SIRVA complaints.

PUNITIVE_PARALLEL — Pattern of physician misconduct documented in §2234 complaint supports §3294 punitive damages theory (malice/oppression/fraud) in the civil case. Prior Board discipline history is admissible evidence of pattern.

COORDINATION — If Hrimnak escape (intentional tort framing) removes MICRA caps, the §2234(f) fraud theory is the administrative track parallel. Both tracks use the fraud/intentional misconduct framing.
